title: 客房服务与需求
goal: 打电话给前台要毛巾、转换插头、叫醒服务，听懂客房清洁和送餐的询问。
tips: 打前台电话先报房间号：Hi, this is room eight-oh-two. 房间号常按两位两位读。
门口挂 Do Not Disturb（请勿打扰）牌，就不会有人来打扫；想打扫就挂 Please Make Up Room。
国外插座和国内不一样，提前问前台借转换插头：Do you have a plug adapter I can borrow?

exchanges.hear: Front desk. How can I help you?
exchanges.reply: Hi, this is room five-twelve. Could I have two more towels, please?
exchanges.replyZh: 你好，这里是512房。能再给我两条毛巾吗？

exchanges.hearZh: 客房清洁，我可以进来吗？
exchanges.reply: Could you come back later, please?

exchanges.hear: What time would you like your wake-up call?
exchanges.reply: At six thirty tomorrow morning, please.

exchanges.hear: Room service. What would you like to order?
exchanges.reply: A club sandwich and a coffee, please.
exchanges.replyZh: 一份总汇三明治和一杯咖啡。

exchanges.hear: Is there anything else you need?
exchanges.reply: Yes. Do you have a plug adapter I can borrow?
exchanges.replyZh: 是的。你们有转换插头可以借我吗？

exchanges.hear: Please put your laundry in the bag and fill out the form.
exchanges.hearZh: 请把要洗的衣服放进袋子里并填好单子。

exchanges.hear: Would you like your room cleaned today?
I'll send someone up right away.

lines.en: Front desk, this is Anna speaking. How can I help you?
lines.zh: 前台，我是安娜。有什么可以帮您？

lines.en: Hello, this is room eight-oh-two. Could I have some extra towels and toilet paper, please?
lines.zh: 你好，这里是802房。能多给我一些毛巾和卫生纸吗？

lines.en: Of course. I'll send them up right away.
Also, could I have a wake-up call at six tomorrow?
lines.zh: 另外，明早六点能叫醒我吗？

lines.en: Sure. Six a.m. tomorrow. Anything else?
lines.zh: 好的，明早六点。还有别的吗？

lines.en: Yes. Do you have a plug adapter I can borrow?
lines.zh: 有。你们有转换插头可以借我吗？

lines.en: Yes, we can lend you one. Housekeeping will bring it with the towels.
lines.zh: 有，可以借给您。客房部会和毛巾一起送过去。

lines.en: You're welcome. Have a good evening.
